legal.questionsBody: We answer every question about personal data, bookings and cancellations — usually within one working day.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We collect as little data as possible, use it only to run tours and the community, and never sell it.
privacy.metaDescription: How Sao Việt collects, uses, stores and protects personal data under Decree 13/2023/ND-CP.

terms.title: Booking & Cancellation Terms
terms.intro: How booking works, prices, cancellations, what happens when it's cloudy, and the safety rules for every stargazing trip.
terms.nonProfit: Sao Việt is a non-profit community project: tour prices only cover running costs and support astronomy outreach, not commercial profit.
terms.metaDescription: Sao Việt's booking flow, prices, deposits, cancellation tiers, cloud-cover and full-moon policy, high-altitude safety and community rules.
